description: Estaciones Volcánicas is a dataset listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Cabildo Insular de El Hierro. Data of the Volcanic Stations deployed on the island of El Hierro, belonging to the Cabildo de El Hierro, installed through the project "El Hierro en Red". Coverage: Cabildo Insular de El Hierro. The portal shows the English title as "Volcanic Stations" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Cabildo Insular de El Hierro. The listing shows 4 download or service links in CSV. The listing shows 2023-11-22 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://opendata.elhierro.es/terminos). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
